meta.name: algorithmic-art
meta.description: Creating algorithmic art using p5.js with seeded randomness and interactive parameter exploration. Use this when users request creating art using code, generative art, algorithmic art, flow fields, or particle systems. Create original algorithmic art rather than copying existing artists' work to avoid copyright violations.

howto.what: Claude 会用 p5.js 制作可交互的生成艺术:先输出一份算法理念 .md,再生成单个自包含 HTML,内含随机种子、参数调节与重新生成控件。
howto.when: 当用户提到用代码创作艺术、生成艺术、流场等关键词时触发。

say.text: 用 p5.js 做一幅基于噪声流场的生成艺术,带随机种子。
say.note: 会先创建算法理念,再输出可交互 HTML。

say.text: 做一个“量子谐振”风格的粒子生成作品,可调参数。
say.note: Claude 会从模板生成含参数侧栏的画布。

say.text: 把这段理念实现为种子可复现的 p5.js 生成艺术。
say.note: 输出结果可复现,同一种子画面一致。

howto.what_en: Claude writes an algorithmic philosophy (.md), then builds a self-contained p5.js HTML viewer with seeded randomness, parameter controls, seed navigation, and regenerate/reset, following the fixed template layout.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user requests art created with code, generative art, algorithmic art, flow fields, or particle systems.

Create a 'Quantum Harmonics' particle artwork with adjustable parameters.
